description: Countdown (4). At the end of your turn, if there's an allied Himeka, Heir to Repose on the field, give X random enemy followers with 4 attack or less "Can't attack followers or leaders" until opponent's end of turn, then banish them. X is the number of crests you have.
reasoning: The implementation applies 'Can't Attack' but does not banish the selected enemy followers as required by the description.
programmedBehavior:
Countdown: 4 turns
Triggers:
  On end of turn own: IF board_name (name="Himeka, Heir to Repose"): Repeat X (crest_count) times: Select 1 random from enemy:follower WHERE attack≤4, not cant_attack THEN: Give Can't Attack to selected:follower; Grant keyword to selected:follower
